$description: Linux Hello design tokens (W3C Design Tokens Community Group format). Source of truth for colour.md and typography.md.

blue.$description: Hello Blue: primary brand field. Not for text on white (3.52:1).

blue-300.$description: Links and highlights on dark surfaces (7.02:1 on shadow).

blue-600.$description: Links and buttons on light surfaces (4.53:1 on white).

blue-800.$description: Blue body text, AAA (7.01:1 on white).

navy.$description: Lit body tone; ink; raised dark surface.

shadow.$description: Shaded body tone; default text; dark surface.

white.$description: Lit belly tone; light surface; text on blue (large only).

mist.$description: Shaded belly tone; alternate light surface.

orange.$description: Beak Orange: accent. Text only on navy or shadow.

text.$description: Large text only (24 px, or 18.66 px bold).

tile-mark-height-ratio.$description: Penguin height as a share of the tile side.

horizontal-cap-height-ratio.$description: Wordmark cap height as a share of mark height.

horizontal-gap-ratio.$description: Gap between mark and wordmark as a share of mark height.

mark-clear-space-ratio.$description: Clear space around the mark alone, as a share of mark height.
